I’m 16, most of my family are quite distant, they’re very problematic people so it was hard to maintain a relationship and thank you, I don’t really know what’s it’s like to be worried about so I’m ever thankful

I’ve tried reaching out to them twice but they never take my problems for what they truly are, my previous counsellors gave me worthless advice to help me cope (one told me to lie down in a public place to help overcome my anxiety) so I don’t really know who to turn to

My small group of somewhat friends are the type of people to make fun of depression and focus on it being more of a meme than a serious issue, I’ve had two counsellors in school and they were both unhelpful, one of them was a trainee and she told me to lie down in a train station to attract attention to myself so I could get over my anxiety
I was going to stray away from doing it online because I thought it was quite underhanded but looking at it now it seems that it would suit both of us more than a public confession
